en.headline: Windy weekend ahead with mainly cloudy skies and occasional rain patches
en.dek: The Observatory said Saturday and Sunday will see east to northeast winds of force 5 to 6, occasionally stronger offshore, with temperatures between 25 and 28 degrees.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said a northeast monsoon would continue to affect the coast of Guangdong over the weekend, bringing windy conditions to the territory.

On Saturday, which marks the start of the Lidong solar term, the weather is expected to be mainly cloudy with one or two rain patches in the morning and at night, and bright periods in the afternoon. Temperatures will range from 25 to 28 degrees Celsius, with east winds of force 5 to 6, occasionally force 7 offshore and on high ground.

Sunday is forecast to remain mainly cloudy with one or two light rain patches at first and sunny intervals during the day. East to northeast winds of force 5 will prevail, occasionally force 6 offshore at first and up to force 7 on high ground, with temperatures again between 25 and 28 degrees. Significant rainfall is not expected.
The Observatory added that a stronger northeast monsoon is expected to bring appreciably cooler temperatures early next week.

zh.headline: 周末風勢頗大 大致多雲間中有雨
zh.dek: 天文台表示周六日吹東至東北風5至6級，離岸及高地間中更強，氣溫介乎25至28度。
body: 香港天文台表示，東北季候風將於周末繼續影響廣東沿岸，本港風勢頗大。
周六為立冬節氣，預料大致多雲，早晚有一兩陣雨，下午部分時間天色明朗。氣溫介乎25至28度，吹東風5至6級，離岸及高地間中7級。
周日大致多雲，初時有一兩陣微雨，日間短暫時間有陽光。吹東至東北風5級，初時離岸間中6級，高地達7級，氣溫同樣介乎25至28度。顯著降雨機會低。
天文台補充，下周初另一股較強東北季候風將帶來明顯降溫。
